# WIRED

> WIRED is a leading technology, science, culture, and business publication covering AI, cybersecurity, consumer tech, and investigative journalism with exclusive interviews, video content, and product reviews.

WIRED delivers breaking tech news, in-depth investigations, and expert analysis across multiple platforms including articles, magazines, podcasts, videos, and livestreams. The publication focuses heavily on AI developments, security threats, Silicon Valley trends, and consumer technology reviews.

## Key Topics

- AI and Machine Learning
- Cybersecurity and Hacking
- Consumer Technology
- Silicon Valley
- Investigative Journalism
- Product Reviews
- Electric Vehicles
- Quantum Computing
- Defense Technology
- OpenAI and Claude
- iPhone Security
- Tech Leadership
- Breaking News
- Subscriber Content
- Gear and Deals

## Core Content Hub

- [WIRED Homepage](https://www.wired.com): WIRED homepage with tech, science, culture, business news and product reviews
- [Magazine](https://www.wired.com/magazine): WIRED magazine cover stories on AI, China, renewable energy, and journalism
- [Newsletters](https://www.wired.com/newsletter): WIRED newsletter subscriptions including Daily, Gear, and Science newsletters

## Video and Audio Content

- [WIRED Podcasts](https://www.wired.com/podcasts): WIRED podcast directory covering tech, culture, business, and science
- [Video](https://www.wired.com/video): WIRED video interviews and documentary series on tech leaders and AI
- [Livestream AMAs](https://www.wired.com/livestreams): WIRED livestream AMAs on AI, tech, electric vehicles, and subscriber exclusives

## AI and Security Coverage

- [Justice Department Says Anthropic Can't Be Trusted With Warfighting Systems](https://www.wired.com/story/department-of-defense-responds-to-anthropic-lawsuit): Anthropic DOD lawsuit over Claude AI military use restrictions
- [Why Walmart and OpenAI Are Shaking Up Their Agentic Shopping Deal](https://www.wired.com/story/ai-lab-walmart-openai-shaking-up-agentic-shopping-deal): Walmart OpenAI partnership pivot to Sparky chatbot in ChatGPT and Gemini
- [Hundreds of Millions of iPhones Can Be Hacked With a New Tool Found in the Wild](https://www.wired.com/story/hundreds-of-millions-of-iphones-can-be-hacked-with-a-new-tool-found-in-the-wild): iPhone security vulnerability DarkSword exploit threat analysis
- [A Quantum Leap for the Turing Award](https://www.wired.com/story/a-quantum-leap-for-the-turing-award): Bennett and Brassard win Turing Award for quantum information theory

## Investigative Journalism

- [The Big Interview](https://www.wired.com/the-big-interview): Interview series with tech leaders, CEOs, and AI industry figures
- [He Built the Definitive Epstein Database—and It Consumed His Life](https://www.wired.com/story/he-built-the-definitive-epstein-database-and-it-consumed-his-life): Investigative journalism on data engineer's Epstein network database project
- [Confessions of the ICE Agent Whisperer](https://www.wired.com/story/confessions-of-the-ice-agent-whisperer): Investigative journalism on Trump administration immigration enforcement
